full_judgment: 16. Ordinance 54 of 1985 has created a special forum to deal with a property which has been enlisted under section 5 as abandoned property. A special procedure has also been made therein to decide those cases. A legal presumption has also been attached under section 5(2) to the list published under sub-section (1) as a conclusive evidence that the enlisted property is an abandoned property. Of course it is a rebutable presumption. The writ petitioner having already availed of the remedy under a special law the High Court Division was not at all justified in declaring that the disputed properties are not abandoned properties only because the Rule Nisi had been obtained as far back as in 1989. Moreover there was no paper before the High Court Division to show that the cases instituted in the Court of Settlement had already been withdrawn either before the institution of the writ petition or before its disposal.
